mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id, p.team_id, p.name, p.category, p.road_address, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.source, p.source_link, p.created_by, COALESCE(u.login_id, p.created_by::text) AS created_by_login_id, (SELECT comment FROM recommendations r WHERE r.place_id = p.place_id AND r.user_id = p.created_by LIMIT 1) AS memo, p.consensus_achieved_at, p.consensus_member_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM places p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.created_by = u.user_id WHERE p.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.place_id, p.team_id, p.name, p.category, p.road_address, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.source, p.source_link, p.created_by, COALESCE(u.login_id, p.created_by::text) AS created_by_login_id, (SELECT comment FROM recommendations r WHERE r.place_id = p.place_id AND r.user_id = p.created_by LIMIT 1) AS memo, p.consensus_achieved_at, p.consensus_member_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM places p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.created_by = u.user_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT COALESCE(u.login_id, r.user_id::text) FROM recommendations r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
SELECT COALESCE(u.login_id, v.user_id::text) FROM place_visits v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.user_id WHERE v.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY v.visited_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( team_id, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, source, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{teamId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{roadAddress}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, 'search', #{createdBy}, now(), now() )
INSERT INTO recommendations (place_id, user_id, comment, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{userId}, #{comment}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (place_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recommendations WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET consensus_achieved_at = (CASE WHEN #{achieved} THEN now() ELSE NULL END), consensus_member_count = (CASE WHEN #{achieved} THEN #{memberCount} ELSE NULL END), updated_at = now() WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_visits (place_id, user_id, visited_at) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{userId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (place_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM place_visits WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
